items.title: Rents up over 7% in year to September, report finds
items.summary: Rents for properties which were advertised to let were 7.3% higher in the 12 months to September compared to the same period a year earlier, according to a report by website Daft.ie.

items.title: Social media platforms failing to remove reported scams

items.title: Woman found in Derry bog was killed over 2,000 years ago
